rule: A candidate replaces an incumbent only if it improves its target metric by more than twice the bootstrap standard error and is not worse by as much on the regression suite.
regression_suite: chains of flat_dagger2 and rough_b3 bit-exact on the GPU
L4 of flat_dagger2 on the G1 and the NAO
the walk on the deployed path under the autonomous reference

g1.training: PPO on the procedural family (70 %) and the walk's plans (30 %), the reward scoring the feet's loads in log space (HUMANOID_LOAD_SPACE=log)

estimator.what: every field of z* but the loads from the body's kinematics, the height from the sole's lowest corner; the loads from the body's encoder
